parameters.top_selection: union of each input's top-L score-threshold set, retaining cutoff ties
parameters.score_universe: same finite residue pairs in both inputs, after separation and applicable gap filtering
parameters.gremlin_L: length of shared original-coordinate interval after fixed item 2 offset
parameters.msatr_L: minimum matrix dimension after historical center-cropping
parameters.gremlin_offset: reuse item 2 Jaccard-selected offset for each cutoff; never optimize Pearson
parameters.missing_scores: exclude from shared universe; never fill with zero
parameters.insufficient_pairs: undefined primary R if fewer than L eligible pairs
parameters.constant_vectors: undefined R; never replace with zero

limitations: Top-L union conditioning can induce negative correlations when different pairs score highly in each input.
GREMLIN donor offsets were optimized using Jaccard, so correspondence is not independent of contact agreement.
Shared native proteins and correlated residue pairs preclude treating all observations as independent replicates.
Native gap-mask alignment historical identity remains unconfirmed; same files as item 2 are enforced.
